A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Co-Me with the same title and authors. Their complete main text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and support comparison, despite substantive method and experimental revisions.

before.justification: V1 reports original depth, pose, point-cloud, runtime, ablation, and edge-deployment results, including supplementary experiments and qualitative cases.

after.justification: V2 reports original results across the same geometric tasks, revised model comparisons and timings, and retained appendix experiments and deployment results.

M1.justification: Section 3.2 and Figure 2 change merging/splitting around each attention and MLP operation into merging before the remaining transformer and splitting afterward. V2 also permits variable per-image token counts within a sequence, replacing the equal-count constraint. Equation 1 changes the reported ranking-pair selection to a uniformly sampled subset.

E1.justification: TartanAir training, all five evaluation datasets, and the three geometric tasks remain. However, v1's explicit online StreamVGGT evaluations with per-frame results disappear. The four-image MapAnything edge demonstration remains, so streaming coverage is reduced rather than entirely removed.

E2.justification: V2 Tables 1–3 add evaluated ToMeSD comparisons and unaccelerated/Co-Me pairs for Pi3 and DA3-Giant, while removing StreamVGGT pairs. VGGT, VGGT-star, FastVGGT, and MapAnything remain. ToMeSD was previously cited and discussed but lacked these direct benchmark comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported environment changes from A100/AMD EPYC to H100/Intel Xeon, and VGGT-star changes from FlexAttention to FlashAttention. Section 4.1 changes the default token group from four to 3×3. Pose evaluation changes from 30-degree/30-cm AUC to 10-degree/10-cm AUC. These materially alter experimental comparability; Appendix B.3 nevertheless retains the old group-size statement.

E4.justification: Figure 5 removes the p=0.9 Co-Me series from the sequence-length sensitivity study and adds ToMeSD. The runtime decomposition is also revised. The confidence-layer, loss, group-size, merging-strategy, and attention-bias analyses remain, as do the appendix success and failure cases.

E5.justification: The ranking-loss versus MSE analysis retains the same 95% confidence-interval reporting in v1 Figure 14 and v2 Figure 15. Neither version adds run counts, seeds, significance tests, or a new uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Benchmark results are extensively replaced and comparator rows added or removed. For VGGT-based Co-Me on 32-frame DTU depth, v1 Table 2 reports 3149 ms, 2.79× speedup, and 0.788 cm L1; v2 Table 1 reports 788 ms, 7.73×, and 1.10 cm. These are results under revised settings, not established same-setting gains. V2 also explicitly reports correcting a MapAnything benchmarking bug.

T1.justification: Equation 1 revises the mathematical definition of the ranking-pair set from all confidence-ordered pairs to a uniformly sampled subset. Equation 6 changes the pose-AUC integration limits from 30 to 10. The merge/split definitions and attention-bias derivation remain, with no new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract's headline changes from up to 11.3× on VGGT and 7.2× on MapAnything to 21.5× on VGGT and 20.4× on Pi3. The conclusion replaces its explicit composability claim with generalization across four models, and the contribution list adds a TensorRT plugin. The central confidence-guided acceleration claim remains.

C2.justification: V2 attributes DA3's smaller acceleration to its shallower architecture and removes v1's explanation of monocular MapAnything slowdown through additional memory access. The conclusion adds future application to vision-language/action models. Appendix A.2 retains the same thin-structure failure explanation and limitations.

D1.justification: V2 documents a variable-length FlashAttention kernel with per-key bias support and a TensorRT plugin, updates hardware details, and drops the explicit one-round warmup disclosure. Predictor placement changes from '15th layer' to 'middle,' while Appendix B.1 still specifies layer 15. The project link and approximately 2,000-step, sub-hour distillation description remain.

R1.justification: V2 adds references to FlashAttention-2, Pi3, DepthAnything 3, and TensorRT, and removes the StreamVGGT reference. The geometric-model background expands accordingly, while the main positioning against pruning and similarity-guided merging remains.

P1.justification: V2 adds an extended-version and bug-fix notice and locally rewrites method, setup, performance, and conclusion passages. The section hierarchy, six-hypothesis analysis structure, and nearly all appendix prose remain; this is not a broad narrative reorganization.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4 are substantially redrawn, including revised method diagrams. V1's separate monocular and multi-view depth tables become one full-width table. Figure 5 changes its displayed series, Figure 7 switches to linear error axes, and the existing edge-deployment figure moves from Appendix C into the main text as Figure 9.

improvement.justification: V2 adds useful direct ToMeSD comparisons, evaluates additional backbones, and reports fixing the MapAnything benchmark. However, unlike v1's consistent four-token specification, v2 states 3×3 groups in Section 4.1 while Appendix B.3 still says four for all main experiments. Its accuracy-preservation narrative also inadequately qualifies new losses, such as DA3's NYUd-v2 L1 increasing from 0.272 to 0.463 m with Co-Me in Table 1. Expanded evidence and these reproducibility and interpretation problems leave the net quality change uncertain.
